Resolves #21273

`headerAlign` adds label-alignment control to `Neo.grid.header.Button`. Before this PR, a numeric column's `cellAlign: 'right'` moved its digits to the right edge but left the header label ~200 px away with no way to close that gap. The new config accepts `'auto'` (tracks `cellAlign` at runtime), `'left'` (default, no change to existing grids), `'center'`, and `'right'`. The CSS sets `flex-direction: row` and `justify-content: end` for right alignment; `justify-content: center` for center; and `> .neo-textfield { order: -1; }` so header filter fields sit before the right-aligned label. A Windows-only path-separator bug in `check-theme-value-files.mjs` that blocked CSS-file commits on Windows is also fixed.

Evidence: L3 (14 unit tests, e2e spec with AC-1/AC-2/AC-4/AC-5 geometry, sorting, column-menu, and showHeaderFilter verified locally and in CI) -> L3 required (ticket ACs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderAlign.spec.mjs` — right edge within 20 px padding; and runtime `showHeaderFilter: true` with field ordered before label (`order: -1`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderAlign.spec.mjs` — `headerAlign: 'center'` puts label center within hidden glyph width + margin of header center |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderButtonAlign.spec.mjs` — "headerAlign: auto — changing cellAlign at runtime moves the label class"; cellAlign cycled left → right → center → left, cls verified each step |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderAlign.spec.mjs` — default header (Invoice) keeps label at left edge; leftGap ≤ 20 px |
| AC-5 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderAlign.spec.mjs` — right-aligned Amount sort click cycles sort; `columnMenu: true` trigger stays in place and opens menu; `showHeaderFilter: true` field stays inside header |
| AC-6 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderButtonAlign.spec.mjs` — 14 unit tests: four enum values, unknown refused, classes per effective alignment, auto reactivity, toJSON serialization |
| AC-7 | `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` — `## Header label alignment` section with values table, per-column example, and `columnDefaults: {headerAlign: 'auto'}` grid-wide example |

## Deltas from ticket
- `examples/grid/export/MainContainer.mjs`: added `headerAlign: 'right'` to the Amount column as the browser e2e vehicle. The ticket noted example column configs were out of scope, but using it as the realistic vehicle required this addition.
- `resources/css/src/grid/header/Button.css`: added `> .neo-textfield { order: -1; }` inside `&.neo-header-align-right` so a header filter field sits before the label, keeping the label at the right edge when `showHeaderFilter: true` (RA-1).
- `buildScripts/util/check-theme-value-files.mjs`: Windows path normalisation fix (`.replaceAll('\\', '/')`) to prevent false-positive failures during pre-commit on Windows.
- `src/grid/header/Button.mjs`: removed `if (oldValue !== undefined)` in `afterSetHeaderAlign` so the class applies at construction time.

## Test Evidence
Local receipts (outside CI):

**Unit** — `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderButtonAlign.spec.mjs`


**E2E** — `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderAlign.spec.mjs`
Six test cases covering AC-1 (Amount right alignment), AC-1/AC-5 (right alignment with `showHeaderFilter: true`), AC-2 (centered alignment), AC-4 (default left alignment), AC-5 (sorting in right-aligned header), and AC-5 (right-aligned header with `columnMenu: true`).

None required.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Checked three cross-cutting edge cases beyond Round 1:
    1. **Centered header + inline `showHeaderFilter: true` (non-blocking):** `&.neo-header-align-center` leaves `flex-direction: row-reverse` in place without reordering `.neo-textfield`, so if an app enables `showHeaderFilter: true` on a `headerAlign: 'center'` column, the inline filter field sits left of the `[label + glyph]` pair inside the centered flex pack and shifts the label right of the column midpoint by half the filter's width. AC-2 and AC-5 scope `showHeaderFilter` coexistence to right-aligned numeric headers, where `> .neo-textfield { order: -1; }` holds the label at the right edge.
    2. **Non-text `editorConfig` filter modules (cleared):** Verified `src/form/field/Picker.mjs:31` retains `baseCls: ['neo-pickerfield', 'neo-textfield']`, so `ComboBox`, `Date`, `Number`, and `Select` header filters all match `> .neo-textfield { order: -1; }` without needing an extra selector.
    3. **Theme token divergence across all five themes (cleared):** `theme-neo-dark` sets `--grid-header-button-justify-content: start` whereas `light`, `dark`, `neo-light`, and `cyberpunk` set `flex-end` (paired with `.icon-right`'s `row-reverse`). Because `'left'` adds no override class and `'right'` sets both `flex-direction: row` and `justify-content: end`, runtime cycling `'right' -> 'left'` restores left alignment cleanly in every shipped theme.
